name: Hollow Soldier
lore: A decayed royal infantryman: rusted plate, chipped shield, a broken straight sword. The faint spectral light in his helm is all that remains of the man.
counterplayHint: Its slash and heavy are both PARRYABLE — parry the telegraphed blow. Raise your guard and it will answer with an unblockable shield bash, so defend only when you must; a heavy strike staggers it for free.

moves.name: Light Slash
moves.intent: Light slash (Parryable)

moves.name: Rusted Jab
moves.intent: Rusted jab — quick, not parryable
moves.effectText: A scrappy jab beneath your guard.

moves.name: Charged Heavy
moves.intent: Heavy overhead slash — winding up (Parryable)

moves.name: Shield Bash
moves.intent: Shield bash (UNBLOCKABLE — ignores your guard)
moves.effectText: The rim of the shield cracks across your stance.

moves.name: Battered Guard
moves.intent: Raising a battered shield (damage reduced)

name: Grave Crawler
lore: A skeletal quadruped with stretched limbs and pale eyes, grave soil caught between its ribs. It hunts from under the ash.
counterplayHint: Its bite and lunge are PARRYABLE and can bleed you — sacred bandages or a rest clear it. When it burrows, it is setting up an UNBLOCKABLE ambush: spend that round healing or repositioning, then weather the eruption. Spectral edges bite poorly here; plain steel works best.

moves.name: Bite
moves.intent: Bite (Parryable)

moves.name: Lunge
moves.intent: Low lunge — fast (Parryable)

moves.name: Burrow
moves.intent: Sinks into the ash — an ambush is coming!
moves.effectText: The crawler vanishes under the ash. Something is about to erupt.

moves.name: Ambush Bite
moves.intent: AMBUSH erupts from below (UNBLOCKABLE!)
moves.effectText: Bone-scraping force from beneath the floor.

name: Ashen Wanderer
lore: A citizen of Veyrath who walked into the ashfall and never stopped walking: robes burnt to lace, a censer-chain wound round one fist, gray powder streaming from the seams of its veil.
counterplayHint: It telegraphs its heavy work: when it stoops to gather ash (GATHER) the censer sweep is coming next round — parry the sweep for a riposte. Its cinder veil is a SPELL, so parry cannot touch it: defend or dodge instead. Below half health it grows reckless and swings without the tell.

moves.name: Lurching Strike
moves.intent: Lurching strike — slow and open (Parryable)

moves.name: Gather Ash
moves.intent: Stoops to gather ash — a heavy swing is coming!
moves.effectText: Powder streams into its cupped fist. The chain goes taut.

moves.name: Censer Sweep
moves.intent: Censer sweep — winding up (Parryable)
moves.effectText: The censer-scourge opens a line of fire across your shoulders; ash catches in your lungs.

moves.name: Cinder Veil
moves.intent: Cinder veil — a breath of embers (Spell — parry fails)
moves.effectText: Its veil parts and a breath of embers washes over you.

name: Rotting Pilgrim
region: Forgotten Outskirts / Cathedral of Broken Bells
lore: A pilgrim of the Cathedral who kept walking after the rot set in: prayer beads wound round a swollen hand, a cracked reliquary breathing at the hip, and a hymn that has gone badly wrong.
counterplayHint: When it kneels to pray (GATHER) it is mending its own rot — that round is free: strike hard or heal up, because it will not pray again for two more rounds. Its rot-touched grasp can POISON you; sacred bandages or a rest clear it. The reliquary breath is a SPELL: parry fails, but defend and dodge handle it.

moves.name: Rot-Touched Grasp
moves.intent: Rot-touched grasp — crawling fingers (Parryable)

moves.name: Pilgrim's Staff
moves.intent: Pilgrim's staff — a heavy overhand strike (Parryable)
moves.effectText: Knotted wood cracks toward your collarbone.

moves.name: Rot-Mending Prayer
moves.intent: Kneels in prayer — mending its rot (punish it now!)
moves.effectText: Black light crawls into the pilgrim's wounds and the rot knits.

moves.name: Reliquary Breath
moves.intent: Reliquary breath — cold black light (Spell — parry fails)
moves.effectText: The cracked reliquary sighs and black light spills toward you.

name: Cursed Executioner
lore: The Crown's last headsman, still on the King's road: plate furred with black moss, a cleaver worn thin as a court writ, and a helm-light that keeps the patience of ledgers. It measures before it cuts. It always measured.
counterplayHint: Every dangerous blow is announced. In its first phase it measures (GATHER) every third round — that is the tell for the Guillotine: PARRY the coming strike for a staggered riposte, or dodge after the measure. The Iron Backhand is fast and cannot be parried; defend or dodge it. Below half health it stops measuring and opens you with the Flensing Cleave (bleeds). While it guards, the damage it takes is halved, so a GUARD BREAK pays. Spectral steel is poor here — plain physical bites deepest.

moves.name: Rusted Cleaver
moves.intent: Rusted cleaver — a working stroke (Parryable)

moves.name: Iron Backhand
moves.intent: Iron backhand — fast, not parryable
moves.effectText: The flat of the cleaver cracks across your stance.

moves.name: Measured Steps
moves.intent: Measured steps — the guillotine is being measured (Parry the next strike!)
moves.effectText: The executioner sets its feet and raises the cleaver high. It is measuring you.

moves.name: Guillotine
moves.intent: GUILLOTINE — the cleaver falls (PARRYABLE — huge, parry it!)
moves.effectText: Falling steel, with the whole road's weight behind it.

moves.name: The Red Opens
moves.intent: The Red Opens
moves.effectText: The executioner's helm-light floods red. It stops measuring. The second phase begins.

moves.name: Flensing Cleave
moves.intent: Flensing cleave — a long opening cut (Parryable)
moves.effectText: The cleaver opens a long red seam; you feel the blood think about leaving.

name: Wraith Priest
lore: A clergy of the old faith, kept by the Blackwood after the Crown burned the record of what it served. Its stole moves without wind; where it walks, the ash falls upward.
counterplayHint: Spectral weapons pass straight through it (fully resisted) — bring plain steel. It telegraphs its Soul Rake with the Grave Litany; the payoff round is the one to DEFEND or DODGE. Every fourth round (every third once it is wounded past 40%) it raises the Veil Ward: damage it takes is halved while the ward holds, and it knits as it stands — break its guard or wait it out. Below 40% it opens the Ashen Rite once, mending itself; strike hard into that round.

moves.name: Grave Chant
moves.intent: Grave chant — cold words, colder touch (Spell — parry fails)

moves.name: Grave Litany
moves.intent: Grave litany — the payoff is coming (DEFEND or DODGE)
moves.effectText: The priest intones the grave litany; the air thins around your throat. The next words will drink your strength.

moves.name: Soul Rake
moves.intent: SOUL RAKE — the litany's payoff (Spell — parry fails)
moves.effectText: Cold fingers rake through where your name is kept.

moves.name: Veil Ward
moves.intent: Veil ward — guarded, and mending (damage it takes is halved)
moves.effectText: The veil tightens into a ward; it knits as it stands.

moves.name: Ashen Rite
moves.intent: Ashen rite — the wounds close (strike now!)
moves.effectText: 'Name me not, and be nameless,' the priest sighs. Its wounds close and the veil burns colder. The second phase.
